record.paper_title: Billiard Dynamics: A Survey with the Emphasis on Open Problems
record.original_question: Let Y be a smooth, strictly convex planar billiard table, and let Φ be the annular phase space of its billiard map φ. An invariant circle is a φ-invariant noncontractible topological circle Γ⊂Φ, and Y is called integrable when the union of invariant circles in Φ has nonempty interior. Is every such integrable billiard table necessarily an ellipse?

evidence.quote: Definition 1. A billiard table Y is integrable if the union of invariant circles in the phase space has nonempty interior.
Problem 1. Ellipses are the only integrable billiard tables.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Y \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be a smooth, strictly convex planar domain, regarded as a billiard table. The billiard map $\varphi$ acts on the annular phase space
$$\Phi = \partial Y \times (0, \pi),$$
sending a pair $(q, \theta)$ (a boundary point and an angle of incidence with the tangent direction) to the next such pair obtained by elastic reflection. An invariant circle is a $\varphi$-invariant non-contractible topological circle $\Gamma \subset \Phi$. Call $Y$ integrable if the union of all invariant circles of $\varphi$ in $\Phi$ has non-empty interior.

Prove or disprove: every integrable smooth strictly convex planar billiard table is an ellipse.
artifact.status_search_result: The Birkhoff conjecture remains open in full generality. Significant partial results have been established: a local version near almost every ellipse (Kaloshin–Sorrentino and subsequent strengthening 2025), the polynomial-integrability version, the rational-integrability version, and the centrally-symmetric case (Bialy–Mironov, Annals 2022).

status_evidence.title: On the local Birkhoff conjecture for convex billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Local version of Birkhoff conjecture proved for perturbations of ellipses of small eccentricity.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is proved locally, not globally.

status_evidence.title: The Birkhoff–Poritsky conjecture for centrally-symmetric billiard tables
status_evidence.snippet: Proves the conjecture for centrally-symmetric C^2 convex billiards.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is established in the centrally symmetric case.

status_evidence.title: Local strong Birkhoff conjecture and local spectral uniqueness of almost every ellipse
status_evidence.snippet: Local strong Birkhoff conjecture near almost every ellipse.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2025) work strengthens local results but does not resolve the global conjecture.
